fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the primary access drive entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions of approach.
• Mark the secondary access point with reflective markers so responders can identify it quickly under low-visibility conditions.
• Keep both access drives clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to move through without obstruction.
• Designate and keep clear a specific area within the parking zone for emergency vehicle staging and turning.
• Post visible signage at the point where the two access drives meet or diverge to help responders navigate to the correct approach.
• Avoid using the turnaround area for permanent or long-term vehicle storage, as this is the most practical space for large emergency vehicles to reposition.
